title: The Long Game: The Pact

texts.details:
We know the name of the hand now. I want the arm.

The Argus Wake does not think for itself. It belongs to a larger thing, the Shadow Council: mortals who serve the Burning Legion of their own will. And the Council's seat is in Kalimdor, in the poisoned forest called Felwood, at a place named Jaedenar.

Word passes between Jaedenar and the Wake by courier. One of them is called Vess. They call him the Quiet, which is a challenge, if you like. He carries a sealed pact. Take it from him, $N, unseen. Only then, when it is safe in your hand, kill him. In that order. A pact taken from a corpse is a pact they know is lost.
texts.objectives: Pick the pocket of Vess the Quiet at the edge of Jaedenar, in Felwood, to take A Sealed Pact, and then kill him. Return to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor.
texts.progress: The pact first. Then the man. Never the other way.
texts.completion:
Sealed, and the seal unbroken. They will not know for days. Good.

It is all here. The bargain between the Wake and the Syndicate: Alterac restored to its lords, in return for a fortress held open. And above the Wake's mark, another, from Jaedenar. An envoy who carries the Council's will to the Wake and back.

You have looted a great many pockets and corpses by now, $N, and I think you have begun to see what is worth taking and what is dross. That eye does not leave you. You will find a little more in everything, from here on.

One job remains. At sixty seasons, come back to me.

idea: The Long Game, level 50: from the wiki, the Argus Wake are members of the Shadow Council, based at Jaedenar, and expected the Syndicate to retake Alterac. Gives the perk of a tenth more coin from loot. Invented: Vess the Quiet and the pact.
